part.text:
Fixed. The bug was that `StdSocketAddr::from_abstract_name` expects the name *without* the leading NUL, but both call sites passed the full path bytes including it — producing an extra `\0` prefix in `sun_path`:

- `tokio/src/net/unix/listener.rs:260` — `UnixListener::bind` now passes `&os_str_bytes[1..]`
- `tokio/src/net/unix/stream.rs:80` — `UnixStream::connect` now passes `&os_str_bytes[1..]`

Validation:
- `cargo test -p tokio --features full --test uds_stream` (includes the `abstract_socket_name` FAIL_TO_PASS test): 8/8 pass; all other `uds_*` tests pass
- An end-to-end check in the container confirmed `UnixListener::bind("\0/tmp/mesh/...")` now listens on the abstract address with a single `@` prefix (verified via `/proc/net/unix`), and `UnixStream::connect` with an abstract path works
- The only failure in the full suite (`fs_try_exists`) is pre-existing and environmental — the container runs as root, so its permission-denied assertion can't trigger; unrelated to this change
